items.summary: Reject the proposed high-priority SearchWoot security queue work this cycle. The requested evidence is materially relevant, but the current mandate rejects high-priority queue work and the existing launch-readiness record already documents the unresolved security and operations gaps. Keep SearchWoot private; do not launch, spend, change credentials, configuration, access controls, schedules, telemetry, or production.

Continue only the six already-active bounded workstreams: 0xroulette revenue-readiness evidence, marineactivity AIS baseline, aliencouncil UAP baseline, fishhooklabs guide improvement, stinkyleftfoot guide improvement, and Americas Strikes affiliate repair. Do not create duplicate queue work or claim success before the existing measurement gates are met.

Reject unsupported financial claims. The supplied $4.92 commission is aggregate and unattributed to sites, direct costs are unavailable, and no experiment outcomes are proven. Do not claim site-level revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, forecasts, or production value.

Owner decision remains required on SearchWoot: prepare an unsent permission request, keep private with no outreach, or end the public-beta pursuit. No outreach, launch, monetization expansion, or production change is authorized without that decision and completion of the existing legal, accuracy, attribution, security, and privacy gates.

Recommendation: continue only the six already-approved bounded workstreams and create no duplicate queue actions this cycle. Existing telemetry supports measurement planning, but zero outcomes are proven, attribution is incomplete, direct costs are unavailable, and failed requests remain unresolved. Do not make site-level revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, or forecast claims.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and authorize only preparation of an unsent permission request. Public launch, monetization expansion, production changes, credential changes, configuration changes, spending, and high-priority queue work remain rejected because source rights, security, accuracy, privacy, attribution, and owner gates are incomplete. Owner decision: approve preparation of the unsent request?

Continue measurement and existing reversible work for 0xroulette.com, marineactivity.com, aliencouncil.com, fishhooklabs.com, stinkyleftfoot.com, and americastrikes.com. Require isolated scope, acceptance criteria, smoke or reachability checks, rollback notes, and measurement at 14 days or 100 new impressions. Do not queue new candidates because available opportunities are already active, filed, blocked by routing, or awaiting measurement.
